records.question: Can bounded candidate scheduling produce better declared outcomes than a greedy baseline?
records.method: 25 paired synthetic instances; lexicographic comparison before and after resource removal.
records.result: Before: 7 better, 18 tied, 0 worse. After: 6 better, 18 tied, 1 worse.
records.limitations: Tiny synthetic problems; candidate uses substantially more search and runtime; no general superiority established.
